start.title: [TODO:ru] When Kings Go to War
start.text:
[TODO:ru] Spring has come. Joab leads your army.
You linger alone in the palace.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Idleness opens the door to sin.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Ride out and lead your men
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] A king belongs with his people.
[TODO:ru] Comfort dulls the heart.

rooftop_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Restless on the Roof
rooftop_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Idle eyes will find a wound.
You should have gone to war.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Yet the evening unfolds...

wine_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Set the Cup Down
wine_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] A king is not led by appetite.
Return to your duty.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step into the cool air.

seeing.title: [TODO:ru] A Woman Bathing
seeing.text:
[TODO:ru] Below, a woman bathes in the courtyard.
Your eyes will not turn away.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Power must not take what is not yours.
[TODO:ru] Turn your eyes from temptation.
[TODO:ru] Curiosity here is the first step to ruin.

ask_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] She Is Another's Wife
ask_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] She is Bathsheba, wife of Uriah.
The knowledge will not save you now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You step further into shadow.
[TODO:ru] You close your eyes and breathe.

summon_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Door Closes
summon_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] She comes. The deed is done.
Word arrives: she is with child.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The weight settles on your shoulders.

uriah.title: [TODO:ru] Uriah Stands Before You
uriah.text:
[TODO:ru] Uriah refuses comfort while his men sleep in fields.
"Shall I lie with my wife?"

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Order Uriah to the front to die
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Murder will not hide your sin.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Get him drunk to send him home
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Deceit breeds deeper deceit.
[TODO:ru] Truth is the only door out.

drunk_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Still He Will Not Go
drunk_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Even drunk, Uriah sleeps at your gate.
His loyalty shames you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Send him to die in battle
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] You sink deeper still.
[TODO:ru] Light is harder than the lie.

front_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Blood on Your Hands
front_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Uriah falls by the wall.
You took his wife and his life.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The Lord sees what you have done.

nathan.title: [TODO:ru] The Prophet Comes
nathan.text:
[TODO:ru] Nathan tells of a rich man who stole a poor man's lamb.
"You are the man."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Do not silence the voice of God.
[TODO:ru] Hiding cannot heal you.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Say: I have sinned against the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Confession opens the way.

threaten_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] Hear the Word
threaten_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Nathan does not flinch.
God's voice will not be silenced.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] Your knees give way.

deny_consequence.title: [TODO:ru] The Truth Cannot Hide
deny_consequence.text:
[TODO:ru] Your silence does not fool the Lord.
A broken spirit He will not despise.

choices.text: [TODO:ru] Say: I have sinned against the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ru] The words break from your chest.

repentance.title: [TODO:ru] A Broken Heart
repentance.text:
[TODO:ru] You fall in sackcloth, weeping.
"Create in me a clean heart, O God."
